purpose: A new independently evaluated 8-hour CARRY-7d cell. It does not alter the locked daily paper route.
signal: cross-sectional rank of settled trailing 7-day funding sum known strictly before each completed 8h decision; long bottom 20%, short top 20%. The settlement at the next entry timestamp is deliberately excluded from the signal because it was not known at decision time.

execution.funding_accounting: position funding is summed over (entry_time, exit_time], so the exit-boundary 8h settlement is earned

data_normalization.funding_timestamp_grid: timestamps within +/-1 second of an 8h UTC boundary are snapped to the nearest boundary
data_normalization.bar_gap_rule: drop the affected symbol arm entirely; never row-shift across a cadence gap
data_normalization.zombie_rule: positive base and quote volume plus a funding settlement no older than 8h

universe: fixed discovery-42 and disjoint symbol-holdout-33 from clean_oos_protocol_v1.json

statistics.joint_circular_outcome_shifts: all unique eligible shifts, capped at 999; report actual permutation_n per cell

headline: base next-8h-open, 10bps-per-leg, double-holdout replay is printed first; compare against a daily CARRY-7d arm rebuilt on the same symbols, funding snapshot, cutoff and cost assumptions
inactive_period_policy: Post-cutoff headline cells must have zero internal inactive bars and abort otherwise. Pre-cutoff context preserves rare inactive bars as cash returns and reports internal_inactive_periods explicitly; they are never silently dropped.
no_tune_rule: Exactly this one 8h cell is evaluated. No rebalance frequency, quantile, lookback, universe, or cost variant may be selected after observing its result.
promotion: A result can only nominate a separate future paper-v2 experiment; it cannot replace or tune the current daily paper experiment.
